definition: ProperPart p f is strict constituenthood in the spatial-distribution reading: p is a constituent of f and is not identical to f. The vocabulary supplies no extensional mereology or measure; IndivisibleForms explicitly forbids these constituents for the admitted Forms. It is not participation.
note: Additive interface for issue #259. Parmenides 130e–131e and 133b–134e, Phaedo 74b–d / 100d–e and Aristotle Metaphysics I.9 motivate these contrasts; none defines the modern typed interface. Sourcing a replacement would require a passage fixing this exact scope.
